# Static front sprites — still need animation

*Regenerated by full scan of all 518 `gfx/pokemon/*/` folders on 2026-08-15.*
*Supersedes `UNANIMATED_FRONT_SPRITES.md`, which was badly out of date.*

**43 folders** have a single-frame `front.png` — a plain square block (40x40 /
48x48 / 56x56) with no strip stacked below it. **34 are real Pokémon; 9 are the
Kanto starter `_clone` folders.** Tyranitar was dropped from the wanted list on
2026-08-21 (still static, but no animated sprite is wanted), so **33** are
actually queued for work.

**Detection method (this pass):** read the actual PNG IHDR of every
`gfx/pokemon/*/front.png`. `height / width` = number of frames on the sheet, so
`height == width` means one frame and nothing to animate. This is measured from
the image itself, not inferred from `anim.asm` — the previous list guessed from
anim data and drifted badly. Cross-checked against `anim.asm` / `anim_idle.asm`
max frame index for every folder.

## Kanto starter clones (9) — also static

These are real entries in `constants/pokemon_constants.asm` (`$fc`–`$104`) and
have **no per-folder `anim.asm`** — their animation is written inline in
`gfx/pokemon/anims.asm` as `frame 0, 20`. If you animate them you'll need to
swap those inline stubs for `INCLUDE "gfx/pokemon/<name>/anim.asm"`.

```
bulbasaur_clone (40x40)   ivysaur_clone (48x48)     venusaur_clone (56x56)
charmander_clone (40x40)  charmeleon_clone (56x56)  charizard_clone (56x56)
squirtle_clone (40x40)    wartortle_clone (48x48)   blastoise_clone (56x56)
```

---

## Has an animation strip but the anim is zeroed out

**Sirfetch'd (`sirfetch_d`) — 56x504, 9 frames on the sheet.**
The sprite and its generated `frames.asm` (8 frame defs) are fully built, but
both `anim.asm` and `anim_idle.asm` are just `frame 0, 16 / endanim`. It renders
as a still image in game. **Only the anim script needs writing — no new art.**

---

## Frame overruns (anim references frames the sheet doesn't have)

These will pull garbage tiles at runtime.

| Folder | Sheet | Valid frames | `anim.asm` references up to |
|--------|-------|--------------|------------------------------|
| `walrein` | 56x280 | 0–4 | **8** — overruns by 4 |
| `sealeo`  | 56x448 | 0–7 | **8** — overruns by 1 |

Both were given the standard 9-frame Spheal-line anim script, but only Spheal's
sheet (40x480, 12 frames) is actually long enough. Either shorten the two anim
scripts to their real frame counts or re-export longer sheets.

---

## Orphan sprite folders (not in the game)

`gfx/pokemon/electrike/` (40x240, 6f) and `gfx/pokemon/manectric/` (56x280, 5f)
contain only `front.png` + `back.png` — no `anim.asm`, no palettes, no entry in
`constants/pokemon_constants.asm`, `data/pokemon/base_stats/`, or
`gfx/pokemon/anims.asm`. The art exists and is animated; nothing references it.
Either wire the line in or delete the folders.

---

## Stale build artifacts

`frames.asm`, `bitmask.asm`, `front.animated.tilemap` and `front.dimensions` are
generated by the Makefile from `front.png`. Six folders have `frames.asm` that
no longer matches their PNG — the sprite was replaced after the last build:

```
golett  golurk  pikachu  sealeo  spheal  walrein
```

A `make clean && make` regenerates them. (`pikachu` is the notable one: its sheet
is now 9 frames but `frames.asm` still only defines 5.)
